subject: txn: check `max_execution_time` when locking keys (#63000)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s executor changes vs its parent: it scopes `max_execution_time` to SELECT via `StmtCtx.InSelectStmt` (so `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE/SHARE` is included), adds a shared `checkMaxExecutionTimeExceeded` guard before pessimistic locking in `SelectLockExec`, `PointGetExecutor`, and `BatchPointGetExec`, and sets `tikvstore.LockCtx.MaxExecutionDeadline` (enabled by the client-go bump) so lock waiting respects `max_execution_time` while DML remains governed by `innodb_lock_wait_timeout`. No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found.
